Etrasimod is an S1P receptor modulator drug utilized in the treatment of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD). Within the Danish healthcare tracking system, the drug recently reached a new administrative milestone regarding its data registration and clinical tracking.

As of April 1, 2025, it became possible to officially report treatments administered with etrasimod in the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret) using the designated SKS treatment code BWHP148 [^src1]. This development is part of a broader effort detailed in the DANIBD 2024/25 report to improve the data foundation for medical treatments, which includes implementing new treatment codes for modern biologics and JAK inhibitors in the national registry. 

Despite this new coding capability, etrasimod is not yet included in DANIBD's formal quality reporting. This omission is due to a lack of integration with the Hospital Medicine Register (Sygehusmedicinregisteret), meaning that while the treatments can be logged in the patient register, they cannot yet be fully tracked and reported in the clinical quality databases.
